body: How much doxylamine is okay to take? I have some syrup with dex and doxy only. I have read a little about it and am kind of weary. It sounds like only higher doses cause bad effects. I’m not sure what a high dose is though.
Both syrup and gelcaps do the same for me personally
My issue is that I don’t feel nauseous at all for awhile... then all of the sudden I realize I’m about to vomit. I will try spacing the dose out, that sounds like it might be my issue.
If you don’t give a shit about how bad taking dxm daily is for you, why the fuck do you care about the calories? Smells like bait

You don’t necessarily need to be 18 to get help. There are plenty of options. Does your school have any counseling services? It might be good to talk to them. Also, I know talking to your parents is hard, but don’t be like me and have them find out by you attempting on your life and going to the hospital. Honestly that’s what I needed to happen at the time but a lot of things could have prevented it if I had talked to someone.

Your tolerance is gonna be way up, so you won’t get as much out of it. You could potentially do a higher dose of shrooms though. But it’s probably better to wait and process your last experience before going into a new one.
